messages.body:

I attempted to reach Jens Hagedorn through Performance Talent Consulting, Kestria Mexico, but the receiving domain rejected both the direct and candidate-resume routes. I am therefore contacting Kestria Global and would appreciate your assistance routing my profile to Jens or the appropriate partner.

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
